label: Bible Study
prompt: But I say unto you, Love your _____, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
verse: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
note: The hardest line in the Sermon on the Mount — love aimed at the people least likely to return it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Is any thing too _____ for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.
verse: Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.
note: Asked after Sarah laughed at the idea of a baby at ninety. A year later, she named him Isaac — 'laughter.'

label: Sunday School
prompt: And David put his hand in his bag, and took thence a stone, and _____ it, and smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead; and he fell upon his face to the earth.
verse: And David put his hand in his bag, and took thence a stone, and slang it, and smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead; and he fell upon his face to the earth.
note: 'Slang' is the KJV's past tense of sling — one stone, one shot, and Goliath fell face first.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then they that feared the LORD spake often one to another: and the LORD hearkened, and heard it, and a book of _____ was written before him for them that feared the LORD, and that thought upon his name.
verse: Then they that feared the LORD spake often one to another: and the LORD hearkened, and heard it, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared the LORD, and that thought upon his name.
note: While cynics said serving God was pointless, the faithful kept talking — and heaven kept minutes.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: _____ the time, because the days are evil.
verse: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
note: 'Redeeming the time' — buying up every opportunity, because the days are evil. Time management, Pauline edition.
